en: Psalms 33

p.src: 1  Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

en: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
u.src: 1  Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

p.src: 2  Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

en: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
u.src: 2  Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

p.src: 3  Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

en: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
u.src: 3  Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

p.src: 4  For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

en: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
u.src: 4  For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

p.src: 5  He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.

en: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.
u.src: 5  He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.

p.src: 6  By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

en: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
u.src: 6  By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

p.src: 7  He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

en: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
u.src: 7  He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

p.src: 8  Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

en: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
u.src: 8  Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

p.src: 9  For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

en: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
u.src: 9  For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

p.src: 10  The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

en: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
u.src: 10  The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

p.src: 11  The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

en: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
u.src: 11  The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

p.src: 12  Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
u.src: 12  Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

p.src: 13  The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

en: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
u.src: 13  The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

p.src: 14  From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

en: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
u.src: 14  From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

p.src: 15  he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

en: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
u.src: 15  he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

p.src: 16  There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
u.src: 16  There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

p.src: 17  A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

en: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
u.src: 17  A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

p.src: 18  Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

en: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
u.src: 18  Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

p.src: 19  to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

en: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
u.src: 19  to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

p.src: 20  Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.

en: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.
u.src: 20  Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.

p.src: 21  For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

en: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
u.src: 21  For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

p.src: 22  Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.

en: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.
u.src: 22  Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.
